text: How long should an ideal first date be? Short answer? Aim for about two hours. In other words, it should not be too short or too long. If it's too short, you don't even have time to build attraction. It feels rushed. But if it drags on for hours, you both get tired, run out of things to say, and the aftertaste is bad. So aim for about two hours. That's the sweet spot. Enough time to connect, vibe, and maybe even build some physical contact. But still short enough to leave her wanting more. Remember, it's better she leaves thinking, I wish it lasted longer, than when will this end. Keep it simple, keep it tight, and it's strong.
